changelog: 🌐 100% Free & Open Source: Complete open-source transition under permissive MIT License with public GitHub repository
📱 Mobile Touch Scrolling Architecture: Fixed focus screen 3-card touch interception, enabling smooth native page scrolling on mobile browsers
📦 Multi-Platform Packaging: Separate and cleanly labeled Linux (deb, AppImage, tar.gz), Windows (Installer, Portable), macOS (dmg, zip), and Android (apk)
⚡ Instant Service Worker Cache Invalidation (v1.1.0) with automatic controllerchange reload across mobile & web clients
🧹 Automated 1-Day Storage Optimization: Cleaned past storage bloat and enforced 1-day retention to keep GitHub Actions quota free
